name: profiles normalized extensions, byte totals, and largest-file ties
input: ordinary names, a dotfile, and a mixed-case archive suffix

name: breaks equal extension-byte totals lexicographically
input: two extensions with four bytes each
test:
records = [
    {'path': 'guide.MD', 'size_bytes': 4},
    {'path': 'a.txt', 'size_bytes': 2},
    {'path': 'b.txt', 'size_bytes': 2},
]
summary = profile_file_inventory(records)
assert summary['extension_totals'] == [('.md', 1, 4), ('.txt', 2, 4)]
assert summary['largest_paths'] == ['guide.MD']
